confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Tbilisi price levels, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely; hotel and hostel figures assume July peak-season rates. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer (about 2.2x and 1.25x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure came from search-result text for rba.gov.au pages; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Georgia straddles Europe and West Asia; Europe was chosen from the fixed region list. Anchors were benchmarked against mid-sized Southeastern European and South Caucasus cities such as Yerevan, Sofia and Belgrade.
